abstract: Maintains municipal groundwater permitting and environmental regulatory filings
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance lead (COMPL), responsible for maintaining municipal groundwater permitting, environmental regulatory filings, and drilling mud containment logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal groundwater permitting and environmental regulatory filings（PERM）
information_points.content:
COMPL-PERM-5O9：For the Continuous membrane interface probe transect plan, the municipal aquifer entry permit is cleared across planned investigative drilling pads within the municipal watershed boundary.
COMPL-PERM-4E7：For the Compound-specific isotope diffusion sampling plan, the municipal aquifer entry permit is not cleared for planned investigative drilling pads within the municipal watershed boundary.
COMPL-PERM-M0G：For the High-resolution multi-level piezometer profiling plan, the municipal aquifer entry permit is cleared for planned investigative drilling pads within the municipal watershed boundary.

information_points.title: Drilling mud containment（WASTE）
information_points.content:
COMPL-WASTE-IV6：For the High-resolution multi-level piezometer profiling plan, the certified mud retention basin capacity for active mud circulation pits per drilling pad is 15 m^3.
COMPL-WASTE-AJ8：For the Compound-specific isotope diffusion sampling plan, the certified mud retention basin capacity across active mud circulation pits per drilling pad is 25 m^3.
COMPL-WASTE-HEU：For the Continuous membrane interface probe transect plan, the certified mud retention basin capacity across active mud circulation pits per drilling pad is 35 m^3.
